newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Metalcorp year pre-tax profit A$5.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Metalcorp year pre-tax profit A$5.6 mln.

text.p: Steel fabricator and recycler Metalcorp Ltd said on Friday its profit before tax fell to A$5.6 million for the year to June 30 despite an improved performance in the second half of the year.
Profit for the year was also affected by redundancy and contract payouts and increasing provisions for trading problems in its Queensland operations, Metalcorp said.
Those payouts and trading provisions amounted to A$600,000.
The company said it expected to declare a fully franked final dividend of five cents for the 1996/97 year.
Metalcorp said its markets and recycling division had strengthened considerably and believed it was on track to return earnings per share after tax of 17.4 cents for the 1997/98 financial year.
